concept: Take It Slow: Slow Cafe, Mahavir Nagar, Kandivali West. Four different dishes, four different motions (cocoa puff, burrata split, noodle lift, fry dunk), no pours. Starts at normal reel speed then eases into slow motion with a no-rush ring; ends on the Bombay Cafe Map lockup.
status: v4: food is 2D illustration (L060), 3D kept for map only; sonar pulse added; illustrators running

alternatives.name: Take It Slow
alternatives.note: recommended: speed-ramp from fast hook into slow motion, breathing captions, no-rush ring

alternatives.name: Menu in a Bungalow
alternatives.note: safe: one dish per room card, soft top-down plates

alternatives.name: Sixty Seconds of Nothing
alternatives.note: wild: a single locked shot of a latte settling while the facts type out beside it

dimensions.palette: the cafe's own colours, sampled from its logo and press photos: charcoal #2F2E2C (logo disc) ground, concrete #7C8088 (walls), cool white #F4F5F7 (logo ring, SLOW lettering), soft SLOW pink #E8A5B3 (team shirts) as the accent, sage #9AB89D (mugs) as the second accent. No orange, no cream. User asked for the cafe's colour scheme (overrides L040's avoid-pink); this dusty pink is not Mondegar's hot signal pink #FF3E8A.
dimensions.fonts: Jost (geometric sans, matches the SLOW lettering on the cafe's shirts) + DM Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: cafe name first: 'SLOW CAFE' stamped in two stacked lines with a hard charcoal shadow in frame 1 over the tiramisu French toast (L051); the O is the cafe's tilted logo ring
dimensions.transition: soft dissolve that lengthens through the reel
dimensions.camera: short map dive to Mahavir Nagar, then slow push-ins on flat-lay and table-level illustrations
dimensions.layout: left-weighted headlines, breathing captions, place-card name tag on every food scene
motion_device: speed ramp from fast to slow
globe pendant lights switching on in sequence (scene 3)
place-card flip tags whose words light as spoken
tick-ring progress (48 ticks) instead of a bar
cocoa dust puff on the illustrated toast
sonar location pulse on the map (core, beam, 4 ripples locked to 'Mahavir Nagar')
dimensions.texture: refined flat editorial food illustrations with paper grain (2D, HTML/SVG), shared soft-lit concrete counter; 3D extruded OSM buildings with detail pass for the map only
dimensions.sound: stamp, soft bass hit, knife on toast, chopstick clack, crunch and dip, soft pad, voice at most 1.5 words per second; no pouring, no tea or coffee pour anywhere
dimensions.ending: charcoal end card, large real Bombay Cafe Map stacked lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, Slow Cafe (white tilted-O ring on charcoal) as a smaller line, held 3 s

experiment.move: speed ramp from fast to slow
experiment.hypothesis: A reel that audibly and visibly slows down after a punchy hook stands out in a fast feed and raises watch-through.

new_vs_last_3: pacing itself is the design (speed ramp)
